settings.title: Settings
settings.folderFixed: Chosen at setup; it can't be changed.

setup.welcome: {{name}} works with an AI plan you already have, using your own account. The app doesn't see or keep anything outside your computer: your work stays in a folder you choose.
setup.folderHint: Your work will be saved here.
setup.folderWarning: Don't move, rename or edit this folder by hand: the app depends on it.
setup.enginePending: Not yet cleared for distribution (development only)

folderProblem.not-absolute: I couldn't use that folder. Pick another one.
folderProblem.root: That's the top of the disk. Pick or create a folder for your work.
folderProblem.home: That's your whole home folder. Pick or create a folder inside it.
folderProblem.too-broad: That folder is too general. Pick or create a folder inside it.
folderProblem.protected: That folder belongs to the system or other apps. Pick another one, for example inside Documents.

setup.saveError: I couldn't save your settings. Try again or pick another folder.

engine.noticeProvider: {{engine}} is a service of {{provider}}. What you write here, and the files in your folder that the AI reads, are sent to {{where}}.
engine.noticeAccount: You use your own {{provider}} account ({{plan}}) under their terms. This app is not made or endorsed by {{provider}}.
engine.noticeContent: Answers are written by {{provider}}'s AI with your account. Check what matters: this app is not responsible for what the AI writes.
engine.installText: {{engine}} isn't on this computer yet. I'll install it with {{provider}}'s official installer:
engine.installing: Installing… this can take a minute.
engine.installManual: I can't install {{engine}} myself. Follow the official instructions, then come back:
engine.updateText: This app needs {{engine}} {{min}} or newer; you have {{version}}.
engine.loginText: Sign in with your {{provider}} account. Your browser will open the official sign-in page.
engine.loggingIn: Finish signing in using your browser…
engine.loginCode: If the page shows a code, paste it here
engine.sharedConfigError: I couldn't save this computer's AI engine settings. The file that keeps them (engines.json, in a hidden folder called .humanharness) may be damaged or come from a newer version of the app. You can see it in Finder, or start it over: I'll keep a copy of the old one.
engine.checkFailed: I couldn't check {{engine}} on this computer.

usage.unknown: Your plan's usage shows up after the first message.
usage.noActions: This app doesn't declare any actions.

preflight.title: This is a heavy task
preflight.estimate: "{{action}}" usually uses about {{estimate}}% of your 5-hour window. You have {{left}}% left.
preflight.hint: "{{action}}" can use a large part of your 5-hour window. You have {{left}}% left.

chat.switched: You're now using {{engine}}, so I started a new conversation. The earlier one is saved in your folder.

history.title: History
history.confirm: Go back to this point? Files changed after it will be undone.
history.restored: I went back to that point. Files changed after it were undone.
history.restoreFailed: I couldn't go back to that point. Try again in a moment.

app.loadError: The app couldn't start. Close it and open it again.

errors.engine-not-installed: I can't find {{engine}} on this computer.
errors.session-expired: Your {{engine}} session ended. Sign in again to continue.
errors.out-of-quota: You've reached your plan's limit for now. Your conversation is saved; try again later.
errors.agent-crashed: Something failed and I didn't change anything.
errors.notice: {{engine}} isn't fully set up in this app yet.
